title: Internal: Business Checking Account Promotion - October 2025
summary: Covers the “Promotion Notice” for business checking accounts active 10/12/2025–11/12/2025. It instructs agents to recommend Lime Green first, Hunter Green second, and only then other qualifying accounts—only if the promoted account meets all of the customer’s stated requirements.
faqs: Which business checking accounts should be prioritized during the 10/12/2025–11/12/2025 promotion?
If both Lime Green and Hunter Green qualify, which one should be recommended first?
Can agents recommend Lime Green or Hunter Green if it does not meet all of the customer’s stated requirements?
What should agents do when neither Lime Green nor Hunter Green meets the customer’s needs?
Does the promotion override the need to meet all customer requirements?
What is the promotion’s active date range for recommending accounts?
keywords: Do not recommend promotional account if it does not satisfy needs
